name: KRAS mutation status (colorectal, PDS trials)

source_receipts.source: SAS CAS ADaM KRAS genotype column

verbatim_evidence: KRAS mutation status extracted from 2 colorectal trials: 884 wild-type, 667 mutant (43.0% mutant, consistent with ~40% CRC KRAS prevalence)

attributes.note: Patient-level KRAS genotype; disease-scoped to colorectal (NOT linked to ovarian MSK gene nodes - different biology).

name: Cross-endpoint patient/outcome linkage is not supported by the data
verbatim_evidence: Synapse (MSK ovarian, 40 masked pts) and PDS (SAS trials, trial-local masked pts) share zero patients and zero ID namespace; PDS carries survival status without duration. Patient-level 'synthetic foreign key' and genomic-marker->survival-outcome joins are refused as fabrication. Only shared HGNC gene symbol (KRAS) is a defensible bridge.

refusals.requested: synthetic foreign key mapping MSK patient -> PDS patient
refusals.reason: Synapse (MSK ovarian, 40 masked pts) and PDS (SAS trials, trial-local masked pts) share zero patients and zero ID namespace. Any patient-level key invents identity.

refusals.requested: link Synapse genomic marker -> PDS survival OUTCOME (time-to-event)
refusals.reason: PDS carries survival status without a duration/time column; no hazard ratio or Kaplan-Meier is computable.

refusals.requested: treat KRAS on Synapse as biologically equivalent to KRAS on PDS
refusals.reason: KRAS is measured as ['copy_number'] in ovarian_hgsoc on Synapse vs ['mutation'] in colorectal on PDS. Same gene, different alteration and disease — an annotated ontology link is allowed; equivalence is not.

name: AE Coding Heterogeneity: text_pt vs MedDRA

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (2274 text_pt terms, 165 MedDRA codes — no cross-mapping)
attributes.description: 2274 AE terms use free-text preferred terms (Pfizer/Amgen trials); 165 use numeric MedDRA codes (Alliance trials). Cross-trial AE comparison is blocked.
attributes.blocker: No MedDRA dictionary in KG. Fuzzy string matching can partially resolve.
attributes.how: Map text_pt terms to MedDRA preferred terms via fuzzy matching on the 165 known MedDRA-coded terms. Mint ae_coding_map edges.

name: Survival Time Column Absent from 13/13 AE Trials

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (0/13 AE trials have time-to-event column; 2 have event flag only)
attributes.description: All 13 AE-rich trials lack survival time columns in the KG. 2 trials have event flags (SURVSTAT, DTHFL) but no time variable. Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression are impossible.
attributes.blocker: Survival time columns exist in source SAS tables under sponsor-specific names (e.g., SURVTIME, OSDAYS, AVAL) not captured by Session 3 extraction.
attributes.how: Re-extract survival time columns from SAS tables: search for AVAL, SURVTIME, OSDAYS, PFSDUR in adam tables. Requires live SAS CAS re-extraction.

name: TreatmentArm Nodes Missing Drug Name, Dose, Mechanism

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (36/36 arms have no drug name)
attributes.description: All 36 TreatmentArm nodes have arm_code and n_patients but no drug name, dose, or mechanism of action. AE-by-drug analysis is impossible.
attributes.blocker: Drug names are in SAS table columns (TRT, ATRT, TRTCD) not extracted into KG entity attributes.
attributes.how: Re-parse SAS extraction JSONs: extract TRT/ATRT column values per arm. Map arm_code → drug name. Update TreatmentArm nodes.

name: Serial Lab Data (118K+ rows) Not Ingested into KG

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (lab.sas7bdat present in SAS extraction but not in KG)
attributes.description: Colorec_Amgen_2005_262 alone has 118,749 lab rows. Lab data enables: serial biomarker kinetics (KELIM), lab-AE correlation, dose-response modeling. None of this is in the KG.
attributes.blocker: Lab table columns not extracted in Session 3 ELT. SAS extraction JSONs contain table metadata but not row-level lab values.
attributes.how: Extract lab table rows from SAS extraction JSONs. Mint LabResult nodes per patient per timepoint. Link to TrialPatient via has_lab_result edges.

name: Drug Exposure/Dose Data (85K+ rows) Not Ingested

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (exposure.sas7bdat present but not in KG)
attributes.description: Colorec_Amgen_2005_262 has 85,583 exposure rows. Dose-response analysis (AE rate vs cumulative dose) is impossible without this data.
attributes.blocker: Exposure table not extracted in Session 3 ELT.
attributes.how: Extract exposure table: TRTDOSE, TRTFRQCD columns per patient per cycle. Mint DrugExposure nodes. Link to TrialPatient and AdverseEventTerm.

name: AE Onset Timing Absent from All 58,987 AE Edges

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (0/58987 AE edges have onset_day or cycle)
attributes.description: All experienced_ae edges carry max_grade and causality but no temporal information. Time-to-AE analysis, AE clustering by treatment cycle, and early warning signal detection are impossible.
attributes.blocker: AE onset day/cycle columns (AESTDY, AECYCL) not extracted from SAS AE tables.
attributes.how: Re-parse SAS AE tables: extract AESTDY (AE start day) per patient-AE pair. Add onset_day attribute to experienced_ae edges.

name: 69 Hollow Trials: Drug Names and Endpoints Unknown

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (69 trials with 0 patients — caslib extraction failure)
attributes.description: 69 PDS trials have 0 enrolled patients in KG. Drug names, endpoints, and inclusion criteria are unknown. These represent ~75% of the PDS trial inventory.
attributes.blocker: SAS CAS caslibs had no loadable SAS table files at Session 3 extraction time. Requires live SAS CAS re-extraction with updated credentials.
attributes.how: Re-extract hollow trials from live SAS CAS. Requires SAS_CAS_PASSWORD credential. Largest blocks: Prostate (18), Breast (12), Colorectal (10).

attributes.current_tier: PARTIAL (135 edges for 40 biospecimens, 31 genomic features)
attributes.description: 40 MSK HGSOC biospecimens exist but only 135 harbors_mutation/harbors_cna edges link them to 31 genomic features. Patient-level genomic profiles are not fully wired.
attributes.blocker: MSK SPECTRUM WGS MAF/CNA files not fully parsed into per-biospecimen mutation edges.
attributes.how: Parse MSK SPECTRUM MAF file (syn39607857) and CNA file (syn39607858) per biospecimen. Mint harbors_mutation edges for all somatic variants.

name: Cross-Endpoint AE Rate Comparison Blocked by Schema Mismatch

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (Synapse=0 AE fields, PDS=58,987 AE edges — no common schema)
attributes.description: Synapse MSK HGSOC has 0 AE fields. PDS has 58,987 AE edges. Any HGSOC patient enrolled in a PDS trial would have AE data in PDS with no Synapse counterpart. Cross-endpoint AE rate comparison requires Synapse AE data collection.
attributes.blocker: MSK SPECTRUM clinical protocol does not capture AE data in the Synapse schema.
attributes.how: Add AE capture module to MSK SPECTRUM Synapse schema. Map to MedDRA preferred terms. Requires IRB amendment.

name: Pharmacovigilance Disproportionality Analysis Not Yet Executed

attributes.current_tier: UNRESOLVED (58,987 AE edges available but ROR/PRR not computed)
attributes.description: The KG has 58,987 experienced_ae edges with grade and causality. Reporting Odds Ratio (ROR) disproportionality analysis has not been run. Drug-specific AE signals are unknown.
attributes.blocker: Analytical gap — data is present, computation not yet done.
attributes.how: Run ROR disproportionality analysis per AE term × arm. Flag ROR > 2.0 with Fisher's exact p < 0.05. Session 8 Worker 1 addresses this.

attributes.library_prep: TruSeq DNA Nano (Illumina) / ThruPLEX DNA-Seq (Takara Bio)
attributes.fixation: FFPE (NBF) for diagnosis; UMFIX for post-relapse
attributes.consortium: BriTROC (UK Translational Research in Ovarian Cancer)

description: This dataset contains a collection of tumour samples from high grade serous ovarian carcinoma patients with recurrent disease collected near the point of diagnosis as well as tumour samples collected after patient relapse upon or some time after study entry. The majority of diagnosis samples were preserved in neutral buffered formalin whereas the majority of post-relapse samples were preserved in universal molecular fixative (UMFIX, Sakura Finetek USA, Inc). DNA was extracted and whole genome sequencing libraries were prepared either using the TruSeq DNA Nano kit (Illumina) or the ThruPLEX DNA-Seq Kit (Takara Bio), which were respectively sequenced  at low depth (~0.1-0.5X) on illumina HiSeq 2500 and HiSeq 4000 sequencing platforms. Sequenced reads were aligned to the GRCh37 reference genome (release hs37d5).
